copy.4. Kişisel Verilerin İşlenmesinin Hukuki: 4. Legal Reason for Processing Personal Data and Collection Method
copy.Kişisel verileriniz, web sitemizdeki ile: Your personal data is collected electronically by completely automatic means by filling out the contact form on our website. These data are stated in Article 5/2 of KVKK;
copy.“Bir sözleşmenin kurulması veya ifasıyla: “It is necessary to process personal data of the parties to the contract, provided that it is directly related to the establishment or performance of a contract” and

copy.İletişim formu aracılığıyla paylaştığını: The data you share through the contact form is processed only for the purpose of achieving the above-mentioned purposes. Your data is hosted in secure cloud-based email providers (Google Workspace infrastructure) used to run our operational business processes and email infrastructure. Your data is not shared with any third party or company for commercial purposes, except for legally authorized public institutions.
copy.6. KVKK Madde 11 Kapsamındaki Haklarınız: 6. Your Rights Under Article 11 of KVKK
copy.KVKK'nın 11. maddesi uyarınca veri sahib: As the data owner in accordance with Article 11 of the KVKK;
copy.Kişisel verilerinizin işlenip işlenmediğ: Learning whether your personal data is being processed or not,
copy.Kişisel verileriniz işlenmişse buna iliş: Requesting information if your personal data has been processed,
copy.İşlenme amacını ve bunların amacına uygu: Learning the purpose of processing and whether they are used for their intended purpose,
copy.Yurt içinde veya yurt dışında kişisel ve: Knowing the third parties to whom your personal data is transferred at home or abroad,
copy.Eksik veya yanlış işlenmiş olması hâlind: Requesting correction of any incomplete or incorrect processing and requesting that the transaction be notified to third parties to whom it has been transferred,
copy.İşlenmesini gerektiren sebeplerin ortada: Requesting it to be deleted or destroyed if the reasons requiring its processing disappear,
copy.Kanuna aykırı olarak işlenmesi sebebiyle: If you suffer damage due to illegal processing, you have the right to demand compensation for the damage.
copy.Söz konusu haklarınıza ilişkin talepleri: You can submit your requests regarding your rights in writing to us using the methods specified in the law or directly via the e-mail address info@takt.tr. Your requests will be concluded as soon as possible and within thirty days at the latest, depending on their nature.
